hub.title: Summaries: Book, Movie, TV and Anime Plots and Endings Explained
hub.description: {n} plot summaries of famous books, films, TV series and anime: the main characters, what happens, how it ends, what the ending means, and three questions to check yourself.
hub.lede: Classic novels and plays, films with confusing endings, TV series and anime, one work per page: who is who, what happens from start to finish, how it ends and what it means. Written for students before a test, viewers puzzled by an ending and anyone deciding whether to start.
about: Each page opens with a spoiler-free answer: what the work is and what it is about. Then come the main characters, the full plot in order, the ending explained with its main readings, the themes, and what to know before you read or watch.

Summaries are written from the works themselves and checked against the sources listed on each page, such as Wikipedia, encyclopedias, study guides and reviews in major newspapers. Where the meaning of an ending is debated, the page says so and gives the main readings.

faq.a: Yes, from the plot section on. The short answer at the top and the character list give nothing away; the plot summary and the ending explained tell the whole story, and each of those sections is marked.

From the works themselves, then checked against the sources cited at the bottom of each page. Names, order of events, dates and episode counts are verified; claims about what a creator meant are only made where the creator said so.

faq.q: Can I read or watch the works here?
faq.a: No. cv.cm does not host the books, films or series and does not link to copies of them. The pages only summarise and explain them.
